_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for every campaign fact. Size-dependent design facts (dimensions, battery, weight, electronics variants) live in ../docs/size-s.json and are merged in by tools/facts.py, which fails if the two disagree. Campaign copy blocks (<!--f:...-->), page images, video cards, perks.csv and tools/goal_model.py read from here. Change a value here (or in size-s.json) first, then run tools/build_all.sh.
_meta.size_swap: If the founder changes the size sold (S → S+ or M), change ONLY: size_S (or add a size_<X> block and point product.size_sold_in_campaign at it), ../docs/size-s.json, renders_v10.path, labels.prototype_footage, size_S.cost_factors_vs_M; then re-run tools/goal_model.py, tools/build_copy.py, tools/check_copy.py --strict and the image build. Nothing else in the kit hard-codes a size.

status_tags.proposal: recommended by this kit; the founder decides (see decisions)
status_tags.variable: being finalised; copy shows the range or 'being finalised', never a single invented number
status_tags.estimate: calculated, no measurement or quote yet

rules: Renders are always labelled 'Render (CGI), not a photo.'
Real footage or photos of the M prototype always carry labels.prototype_footage.

Never claim CE, FCC or UKCA before gates.CE.passed is true and the EU DoC is signed. On the live page (scenario after_ce) CE lines come from the passed state; 'not CE-certified yet' appears only in messages sent before the DoC (block ce_now). Never claim SOUL includes, bundles or resells AI.
Never invent backers, press, reviews, certifications or specs.
Anything that shows scale (hand, desk, size graphic) must be size S: renders/v10 (labelled Render (CGI)) or the true-scale vector graphic.
Never write 'incl. VAT' while pricing.vat_registered is false. Prices are final either way.
Never show the planned retail price as an old or struck-through price, or as '% off'.
Never say a ChatGPT account works: only the owner's own OpenAI API key (in development). Never name a grant as a source of money on public pages.

decisions._note: Founder decisions. Nothing is posted on Indiegogo until D1 is written in '03 Decizii/Jurnal decizii.md'. 'kit_default' is what this kit is built with; flip it here and rebuild.

D1.q: Keep the rule 'no customer payment before grant and CE' (campaign after CE, scenario after_ce) or waive it for a pre-CE campaign (scenario before_ce)?

D2.q: VAT + OSS registration (with the accountant). Cross-border B2C sales above €10k/yr (OSS) and, depending on the amount raised and other turnover in the year, the 395,000-lei threshold make VAT likely; it is paid from the money raised, never added to prices.
D2.kit_default: not registered today; VAT modelled as owed

D3.q: Price ladder A (from €199, planned retail €249; goal ~€120k) or B (from €249 = the approved site price, planned retail €299; goal ~€75k)

D4.q: Age on the page: 16+ (site) or 18+ (compliance note)
D4.recommended: 18+ (the AI features need the owner's own API account, which requires 18+); applied as the safe default in the copy

D5.kit_default: RO, DE, AT, FR, BE, NL, IT, ES, PL, SE (GB moved to Late Pledge until the UK gate passes, D13)

D6.q: Marketing cash at risk before the first payout
D6.kit_default: up to €17,500 (scaled to the smaller goal)

D7.q: Launch colours: 3 of the 5 designed finishes (fewer anodising lots and golden samples)

D8.q: Electronics route for batch 1: A = custom round PCB with a pre-certified ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 module (docs/size-s.json 'product'), B = Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-1.75 board inside (size-s.json 'S-P0_dev_board')

D9.q: Delivery promise: keep EU April 2028 / UK May 2028 (~6 weeks of buffer after best-case shipping) or move to EU May 2028 / UK June 2028 (~10 weeks; comparable campaigns slipped 1–13 months)
D9.kit_default: move (applied as the safe default 2026-10-22): EU May 2028, batch 2 August 2028, ~10 weeks of buffer
D9.recommended: move: set campaign.scenarios.after_ce.estimated_delivery to EU 2028-05, UK 2028-06, late_pledge_batch_2 2028-08, reward_delivery_field 2028-06, reward_delivery_remark 'EU: May 2028 · UK: June 2028 (estimates)', buffer_weeks 10, then rebuild copy, images and video

D10.q: Stable Pledge (HC/471): on or off? Can only be switched on before launch and can never be switched off; backers get a 100 % refund window if estimated costs rise more than 10 %.
D10.kit_default: decide at G3: on only if every batch quote and the courier/3PL quote are in writing

D11.q: Who pays the RF/EMC pre-scan and the CE/EN 18031 lab before the campaign (~€42k one-offs)? PoC 1.1 lines L14/L15 cover pre-tests only after the financing contract (est. Aug–Oct 2027) and exclude final CE, so anything done earlier is paid from non-grant money and must NOT also be claimed in PoC 1.1.
D11.kit_default: own money / KREA or friends-and-family loans / Patria Credit, kept out of the PoC budget

D12.q: Batch 1 capacity: how many devices the first batch is planned and quoted for. Rewards beyond it are 'batch 2' with a later month (EU consumer law: the delivery date is an essential term).
D12.recommended: 270 (= the goal batch the timeline was sized for); raise it only with written CNC, anodising and EMS capacity at G3

D13.q: UK in campaign 1? Needs a UK gate: PSTI statement of compliance (support period, vulnerability disclosure, no default passwords), UK WEEE/battery distance-seller arrangements, CE accepted in GB, DAP import VAT.
D13.kit_default: not in campaign 1; open in Late Pledge once the UK gate passes

D14.q: US/Canada: add FCC Part 15 + ISED to the same lab order (~€15k [E], before the campaign) or keep them out of campaign 1?
D14.kit_default: out of campaign 1 (no cash for it before the payout); not a stretch goal

D15.q: Refund policy wording and reserve (lawyer, before G3): full refund before shipping (likely required for consumers anyway) vs. a cut-off when batch orders are placed; size of the refund reserve.
D15.kit_default: full refund until shipping + 5 % reserve, marked 'draft for the lawyer'

product.name: SOUL

colours_launch.later_rule: not offered and not promised in this campaign

product.front: one round black glass, nothing else (no logo, no buttons)
product.microphone_policy: listens only while a finger is on the glass
product.ai: connects the owner's own AI: Claude (own Anthropic API key, plus the Claude app connector), OpenAI (own OpenAI API key: in development; Sign in with ChatGPT: pending OpenAI approval, never promised), or offline. A ChatGPT account/subscription does NOT work. ARTEMIS never includes or resells AI.

voice.status: speech-to-text uses a speech service: today OpenAI's, with the owner's own OpenAI key. Voice for Claude-only owners is in development.
voice.rule: Never show or say 'hold the glass and talk to Claude' for a Claude-only owner unless claude_only_voice_works is true (set it after G1 proves it on the S board).

product.memory: SOUL Memory lives on the device

eyes.birth: each unit is born with one pair from its chip ID; nobody picks them
eyes.same_pair_probability: sum of p^2 over the 120 designs ≈ 0.9 % (about 1 in 112): two SOULs rarely share eyes, but it happens. Never say 'no two are alike'.
eyes.rule: Rarity changes only the eyes. Never price, sell, reroll or auction a rarity.

product.charging: OU, its charging egg, through gold contacts in the foot

age.rule: the page says 'for people aged 18 and over' until D4 is decided otherwise

firmware.status: built and tested on PC and in the simulator (480 px M profile and 466 px S profile); NOT yet run on a real board

thickness_mm.note: product target 23.0 mm (route A, size-s.json dims_mm.d); 25.65 mm with the Waveshare board inside (route B, variants.S-P0_dev_board). Final depth follows D8. Lower bound 23, not 22: docs/12-SIZE-S.md §2.4 rules 22.0 mm out (0.13 mm battery margin).

size_S.glass: round black glass; Ø52 mm flat 2.5D in the product design (size-s.json glass_d) [estimate]

battery_life_internal_estimate_h.status: estimate, internal only: never on the page until measured on a real S unit (battery.battery_life_rule)

indiegogo.extra_holds: elevated-risk creators can be asked for production agreements, manufacturing estimates, escrow/milestone release or guarantees [snippet]

payouts.unpaid_orders: not cancelled by default for campaigns starting after 2025-12-16 (HC/637)

locks.url_and_category: when the Upcoming page is published

indiegogo.endgame: on by default: each pledge in the last 10 min resets the timer to 10 min, once per backer (HC/605)
